title: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation Micro-Credit Scheme
description: Provides small financial assistance to SC entrepreneurs for setting up micro-enterprises and small business units.

title: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
description: Provides medium to long-term financial assistance for commercial, agricultural, and industrial enterprises up to ₹50.00 Lakhs.

title: NSFDC Educational Loan Scheme
description: Concessional education loans for SC students pursuing professional and technical higher education in India or abroad.

title: VCF-SC (Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes)
description: Financial support to encourage entrepreneurship among SC youth driving technology, manufacturing, and innovation ventures.
